Subject: Clarify platform fee unbundling + support SLAs for VPC pilot

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the runtime performance. Procurement asked me to follow up with a couple of commercial clarifications before we take this to legal:

1) Platform fee unbundle: can you quote the VPC offering with the platform fee as an optional line item? Our CFO prefers Opex line items tied to services we actively use; if observability/analytics are optional we may want to buy them separately.

2) Support SLA rebalance: for a 6-month pilot we need a tighter response SLA for Sev 1 incidents (1 hour response ideal). Your standard 4-hour Sev1 window is a blocker for us.

3) Pilot discounts: any standard pilot discount you can offer (timebound, limited to dev/prod parity)?

Could you send a short commercial recap and a draft SOW (we’ll use it to trigger legal review)? Attaching our procurement checklist (linking internally), but happy to take a call if it’s easier.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Engineering, BlueCascade Health

procurement@bluecascade.com

Subject: Re: Clarify platform fee unbundling + support SLAs for VPC pilot

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Quick summary and two options below; attaching a concise commercial offer (Redwood_Offer-v1.pdf) and a one-page SOW placeholder.

Option A — Unbundled (recommended for pilots)
- Core VPC license (metered nodes) — baseline monthly fee
- Observability / analytics — opt-in addon, billed monthly per ingest/retention tier
- Support: Standard Bronze/Silver/Gold tiers (see attachment)
- Pilot discount: 10% off the first 3 months for core VPC license (conditional on 6-month pilot sign-off)

Option B — Bundled (operational simplicity)
- Platform fee includes observability + basic monitoring; higher tier SLAs require Gold support add-on
- Pilot discount: 5% off bundled price for 3 months

SLA note: We can make a 1-hour response SLA for Sev1 available as a paid Gold SLA add-on for the pilot period, provided there is a named escalation contact and a short MSA addendum. That would carry a surcharge (I listed the Gold tier uplift and the one-off SRE standby rate in the attached PDF).

Next steps:
- I’ll loop Marissa (CS ops) to draft a targeted SOW and to enumerate the Gold SLA terms.
- If this looks reasonable, we can produce a DocuSign-ready offer and route for legal.

When’s good for a 30m sync next week? I’m available Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Alex — adding the SOW and support breakdown inline and as attachments. I pulled the Gold SLA playbook and sketched the operational commitments we’d include for a 6-month pilot.

Key SOW highlights (draft):
- Pilot scope: 2 VPC sites, up to 3 operator licenses, full observability optional
- Deliverables: deployment runbook, SLO reports (weekly), on-call escalation path
- Acceptance: basic perf validation (90th percentile latency target) by week 3

Gold SLA (pilot add-on):
- Response: 1 hour for Sev1, 30 minutes for P1 (during business hours)
- On-call: named SRE for pilot window (coverage 08:00–20:00 PT)
- Escalation: 4-hour shipping of hotfix prioritization; monthly operational review
- Pricing: Gold SLA = +18% uplift on platform fee; SRE standby (optional) = flat $6,000/month

Pilot discount: We can extend a 15% one-time credit applied to the first invoice if BlueCascade signs the DocuSign offer within 14 days and commits to a 6-month pilot. This is limited to one pilot per account and non-recurring.

I’ve attached: SOW-draft.docx and Observability-Addon-pricing.csv.

If this matches your needs, Sean — please produce an updated offer (DocuSign) with the unbundled pricing + Gold SLA option ticked and the 15% pilot credit clause.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
